scope: Proposed measurements for separately reviewed future Windows run; NOT_EXECUTED
required: Freeze exact single edited path, old/new raw hash and full source/build identity; resolve its actual owner via CompilationPipeline and actual RSP membership. New source must already be frozen before the compile observation window.

Pin complete actual native owner universe, raw RSP bytes, source membership, output/ref-output paths and actual reference graph including packages, predefined/generated and non-Game owners; derive transitive consumers from real references.

Join Windows canonical lowercase input paths to case-preserving owner names explicitly and uniquely; distinguish historical corrected projection from raw RSP parser behavior. Recompute every new epoch; no inferred native admission bug.

Pin Editor executable/version, checked SDK dotnet/csc, target/subtarget, defines, asmdef/asmref constraints, package lock, compiler options, analyzers/generators/additional/config inputs and all reference bytes. Unclassified inputs/options refuse.

For every retained owner, bind current complete membership/inputs/references/raw RSP/SDK and exact native output paths/hashes to a real successful originating compile and immutable terminal receipt; retain lineage chain. No hash-only path substitution.

For each fresh owner, correlate invocation with run identity and numeric Csc log, actual raw RSP and exact consumed producer reference bytes. Record errors, output/ref-output, ordering and before/after stability. Events or timestamps alone are insufficient.

If a producer changes a consumed reference during a global window, current native checker refuses. A future per-consumer contract would need genuine at-invocation input capture and immutable producer completion before consumer consumption; no retrospective reconstruction.
Measure which consumers Unity actually recompiles. If required consumer Csc is skipped because ref bytes stay equal, keep current composite gate pending; do not label a cache hit fresh.

Keep wrapper/watch exits, same-window sealed closure, settings/source/build census and loaded assembly/domain identity separate from Pipeline reconnect/readiness and actual mission evidence. Preserve failed attempts and full raw logs.
